source_caption:
The Interview follows Dave Skylark, the host of a celebrity talk show, and his producer Aaron Rapoport. After they unexpectedly secure an interview with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, the CIA recruits them to carry out a secret mission during their trip to North Korea.

In The Interview, the story blends political satire, comedy, and action while poking fun at celebrity culture, journalism, and international politics. Directed by Seth Rogen and Evan Goldberg, it stars James Franco, Seth Rogen, and Randall Park.
